name: B10-0218/2025 (The Left) – Immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus - threats from the Investigative Committee
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of all political prisoners in Belarus, including Volha Brytsikava and Aliaksandr Kapshul. It condemns the Lukashenka regime for repression, unfair elections and mistreatment in jail. It asks the European Union and its member states to help Belarusians in exile who face politically motivated charges, to make visas easier for those fleeing, and to monitor political trials. The text is a statement of position and requests; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of demands and condemnations.
- **Who it affects:** Belarusian prisoners, activists, journalists and exiles.
- **What happens next:** The text is sent to EU institutions and Belarusian authorities.
